title: Scheduled graph concurrent recovery contract
scope_not_claimed: multi_process separate interpreters without shared sqlite locking proof beyond sqlite BEGIN IMMEDIATE

questions.who_wins: The caller that atomically wins RunLedger.claim_recovery (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) for the source pipeline_id.
questions.loser_return: Either converge on the winner's terminal recovered mission (same ms_rec_* id and same pipeline_id) or return in_progress/resume_in_progress leaving the occurrence recoverable (OCC_RETRY_WAIT). Never invent OCC_FAILED solely from contention.
questions.uniqueness_invariant: One recovery claim per pipeline; one deterministic recovered mission id per source mission (ms_rec_sha256); graph resumed in place (same pipeline_id); recovered mission run_count == 1 after convergence.
questions.winner_crash_after_claim: Stale recovery lease is reclaimable via reclaim_stale_recovery / lease expiry; claim_recovery rejects only active non-expired leases and terminal recovery states.
questions.stale_claims: reclaim_stale_recovery lists RESUMING claims with expired lease; operators/reconcile can resume again.
questions.atomic_commit_unit: claim_recovery transaction; reopen_pipeline transaction; per-step claims; finish_mission_run; finish_occurrence. Not one mega-transaction across the whole resume.

evidence_distinctions.actual_recovery_failure: Winner completed resume; graph terminal failed; recovered mission failed/blocked with failure_code from graph.
evidence_distinctions.duplicate_recovery_request: Second caller after terminal recovered mission returns idempotent/converged success without second run.
evidence_distinctions.already_recovered: rec mission terminal COMPLETED; recover returns OCC_SUCCEEDED with idempotent/converged.
evidence_distinctions.recovery_in_progress: reason resume_in_progress / in_progress true; occurrence left recoverable.
evidence_distinctions.successful_convergence: All callers that finish after winner reference same rec_id and pipeline_id; occurrence SUCCEEDED; original mission remains FAILED (audit).

preferred_semantic: Two concurrent recovery attempts for the same source graph create at most one resumed graph. Both callers receive a truthful non-failure outcome: either the winning recovery result or an explicit idempotent/already-recovered/in_progress result referencing the same recovered mission id. No caller observes a false terminal failure caused solely by contention.
